answer: Trust edges decay exponentially with a fixed half-life, so reputation reflects sustained honest service rather than a brief burst of activity. EigenTrust-style matrix factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagate support only through established, mutually validated peers; a freshly spawned identity—even one named plume, falcon, or walnut—has near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot meet consensus thresholds without durable, corroborated behavior.
